rules.description: Work orders carry labor, material and tool requirements for planning review.

provenance.note: Product context only; no physical task or permission is inferred.

rules.description: Review start/end constraints and all required resource availability.

provenance.note: Calendar availability is not authorization and does not prescribe this scenario's algorithm.

rules.description: Require administrative approval, adequate order-specific kits and eligible prerequisite evidence; compute cumulative kit arrival bounds.

provenance.note: Fictional reservation, approval and contingent predecessor rules.

rules.description: Reject internal cycles; recompute dependency-resolved work by priority/due/ID after each decision and propagate deferred predecessors.

provenance.note: Deterministic review policy, not an authorization or global optimizer.

rules.description: Search increasing horizon-relative grid starts, fixed area/tool first, then crews by ID, using capacity-one full-duration allocations.

provenance.note: No split jobs, extra capacity, overtime or real schedule writes.

rules.description: Use half-open UTC intervals and containment in one original availability window; reject contradictory existing bookings.

provenance.note: Explicit offsets; union availability only for reporting minutes, never stitch windows to fit jobs.

rules.description: Honor explicit max_search_starts per order; distinguish exhausted search limit from an infeasible fully examined window.

provenance.note: Fictional local workload safeguard, not a business priority or industry standard.

rules.description: Record actual first failed constraints and blocking IDs, then assign explicit review actions for deferred work.

provenance.note: Failures are visible; no invented slot or silent dropped order.

rules.description: Account for every order and separate proposed versus committed resource minutes; emit no-authorization boundary.

provenance.note: Complete contingent review artifact, never safe-to-work clearance.

steps.title: Freeze planning exports
steps.procedure: Inventory all seven logical exports and the supplied planning horizon/cutoff.

steps.title: Validate planning records and graph
steps.procedure: Validate exact input fields, times, references, limits and graph; reject malformed or contradictory bundles.

steps.title: Join order resource and material evidence
steps.procedure: Join order requirements/kits, crew crafts, fixed resources, windows, commitments and predecessor status.

steps.title: Assess preliminary planning readiness
steps.procedure: Compute order-reserved shortages/arrival bounds, administrative status and eligible external predecessor gates.

steps.title: Allocate contingent resource windows
steps.procedure: Process dependency-resolved work with deterministic priority, grid and crew choices while retaining actual failures.

steps.title: Explain conflicts and deferred work
steps.procedure: Expose rejected candidates and explicit owned review actions; never turn planning availability into authorization.

steps.title: Summarize resource occupancy
steps.procedure: Union availability for reporting, clip to horizon and separately sum committed/proposed minutes.

steps.title: Close the planning review packet
steps.procedure: Emit complete ordered orders/proposals/conflicts/queue/load/summary with explicit safety and native boundaries.
